content: Character is higher than intellect. A great soul will be strong to live, as well as strong to think.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Cleverness without moral bedrock is dangerous. True human greatness requires an unshakeable spine of integrity that withstands the storms of life.
practicalInsight: Choose the honorable course of action today even if a shortcut seems intellectually clever.
reflectionPrompt: In what decision is your character being tested more than your intellect right now?
